summary: 四个空格已补出完整肥鱼人物，尾体也保留；中间摆臂仍有重复回摆，头部和衣摆仍有变化。先看连续播放，尚不能判定已解决抖动。
observations: Exactly six lower figures were produced from only two original pose anchors. The four initially empty cells contain visible intermediate characters with hair, costume, tail bodies, hands and shoes.

The model moved grid dividers and enlarged the effective cells. Actual-output split windows were measured and revised to retain the complete shoe soles. Original input and output sheets remain preserved.
Each old/new sequence uses its own constant scale and the same endpoint-only registration algorithm. Original intermediate landmarks were not used for fitting either sequence.
Middle poses are synthesized alternatives, not established replacements for IMG001..004. End-pose wrist overlap is not precisely locked to the original guide.

Arm placement alternates through similar front/back presentations across the middle panels rather than forming a strictly monotonic swing. Face/hair/hem/tail shapes still vary; a smoother result is not assumed from successful filling alone.
No local limb warping, repainting, extra image task or NPK creation was performed. Prior NPK files and accepted walk record remain unchanged.
